feedback.worked_solution:
To find the rate, we substitute $T=60$ into our equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}T}{\text{d}t}{|}_{T=60} & =-0.03(T-25){|}_{T=60} \\  & =-0.03(60-25) \\  & =-0.03(35) \\  & =-1.05\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, when $T={60}^{∘}C,$ the object's temperature decreases at a rate of $1.05$ degrees per minute.
